name: Discord Rich Presence
description: Display currently playing media from Jellyfin as Discord Rich Presence activity without Discord SDK.
overview: Seamlessly integrates Jellyfin media playback into Discord Rich Presence with zero telemetry, local IPC, and opt-in artwork lookups.

versions.changelog:
- **Security & privacy hardening** — external metadata lookups are now opt-in and disabled by default
- **HTTPS-only Public Server URL** with rejection of localhost, private/LAN addresses, userinfo, and DNS-rebinding bypasses
- **IPC hardening** — application ID validation, read/write timeouts, PING/PONG handling, Windows pipe-owner check, user-private Unix socket directory
- **Artwork resolution limits** — 512-entry cache, 512 KB response cap, HTTPS + artwork-CDN allowlist for provider images
- **Provider ID validation** for IMDb, TMDb, AniList, and MusicBrainz action buttons
- **Pause grace period `0` fix** and corrected configuration defaults in the web UI
- **Release pipeline fix** — post-upload checksum verification, manifest updated only after verification, corrected historical checksums
- **Supply chain hardening** — pinned GitHub Actions, locked NuGet restore, vulnerability gate, patched System.Text.Json/System.Text.Encodings.Web

- **Interactive Discord Action Buttons**:
- **Dedicated Music & Album Artwork Resolution**:
- **IPC Connection Cooldown & Backoff**:
- **Discord Rejection & Opcode Validation**:
- **Multi-Session Ordering & Seamless Transition**:
- **UI Settings Harmonization**:
---

- **Fixed: Discord Rich Presence not working on Linux at all**
- **Fixed: All plugin settings reset to defaults when upgrading from v1.1.0.0 → v1.2.0.0**
---

- **Fixed: Discord Rich Presence disappearing after 1-2 minutes of playback**
- **Fixed: seek detection**
- **User Filter (Multi-User Servers)**
- **⏸ Pause State with Grace Period**
- **Improved Settings Page**
- **General** — Application ID, poll interval, public server URL
- **User Filter** — Target username / user ID
- **Playback Display** — Episode info, media banner, elapsed time
- **Pause Behaviour** — Show pause state, grace period (minutes)
---

- **Full Non-Anime Movie Support with Official IMDb Posters**:
- **Exact IMDb ID Lookup**:
- **Smart Media Classification**:
- **AniList Title Validation**:
- **Extended Movie Detection**:
- **Production Year & Hover Details**:
- **Throttled Progress Events**: Playback progress events are now throttled to avoid flooding Discord's IPC pipe with redundant updates.
- **Cache TTL & Housekeeping**: Artwork cache now uses time-to-live expiration and bounds in-memory entries, preventing stale entries and memory growth.
- **Discord RPC Length Protection**: Sanitization ensures minimum string lengths to prevent Discord IPC drops.
---

- Fixed Discord activity disappearing after a few seconds: the plugin now correctly drains Discord's acknowledgment response after each activity update, preventing pipe buffer overflow and connection drops

- Automatic public anime, TV show, and movie poster resolution via AniList GraphQL, TVMaze, and Wikipedia for local servers
- Support for optional PublicServerUrl configuration for direct Jellyfin cover proxying
- Guaranteed high-resolution Jellyfin artwork and PNG play badge fallback
- Zero-telemetry, local IPC Named Pipe / Unix Domain Socket

- Initial native C# release for Jellyfin 12.1+ and 10.9+
- Event-driven Discord Rich Presence integration via ISessionManager
- Support for Movies, TV Series (SxxExx), and Music
- Embedded configuration page in Jellyfin Admin Dashboard
- Zero-telemetry, local IPC Named Pipe / Unix Domain Socket
